title: Bubblegum Takes a Day Off
synopsis: Marceline dares Princess Bubblegum to take one full day off, and the kingdom does not fall apart, which is somehow worse.
plot:
Marceline finds Bubblegum asleep face-down on a spreadsheet at four in the morning and issues a challenge: twenty-four hours, no ruling, no science, no checking in. Bubblegum accepts mostly out of spite. Peppermint Butler is left in charge with strict instructions and a binder.

At the lake, Bubblegum cannot relax. She keeps narrating the chemistry of the water. Marceline confiscates her notebook, then her backup notebook, then the notebook she had hidden in her hair. Meanwhile, back in the kingdom, the Banana Guards handle a minor gumdrop landslide with surprising competence, and Peppermint Butler settles a trade dispute by simply being terrifying.

By evening Bubblegum is finally floating on her back looking at clouds when a Banana Guard arrives to report that everything is fine. She is briefly devastated that they didn't need her. Marceline points out that building something that works without you is the whole point. Bubblegum admits that is a good thing, then asks if the twenty-four hours are up. They are not. She stays.
transcriptText:
Marceline: Bonnie. Bonnie. You're drooling on a bar chart.
Princess Bubblegum: I'm not sleeping. I'm resting my eyes between data points.
Marceline: One day. Twenty-four hours. No princess stuff.
Princess Bubblegum: The kingdom would collapse.
Marceline: Then it deserves to.
Princess Bubblegum: ...Fine. Fine! Peppermint Butler!
Peppermint Butler: Already holding the binder, ma'am.
[The lake. Bubblegum sits rigidly on a towel.]
Princess Bubblegum: The dissolved oxygen content in this lake is remarkably—
Marceline: Nope. Give me the notebook.
Princess Bubblegum: What notebook?
Marceline: The one in your hair.
Princess Bubblegum: [handing it over] That's the last one.
Marceline: And the one in your sock.
Princess Bubblegum: [handing it over] I hate this.
[Candy Kingdom. A gumdrop landslide.]
Banana Guard 1: Okay everybody, single file, away from the gumdrops.
Banana Guard 2: We're doing great!
Colonel Candy Corn: Where is the princess?
Peppermint Butler: Unavailable. I am the princess today. Do you have a complaint?
Colonel Candy Corn: ...No. No, sir.
[The lake. Sunset. Bubblegum floats on her back.]
Princess Bubblegum: This is... okay. This is okay.
Banana Guard: Princess! Princess! Report from the kingdom!
Princess Bubblegum: [sitting up] What happened?!
Banana Guard: Nothing! Everything's fine! We fixed it!
Princess Bubblegum: You... fixed it.
Banana Guard: Yeah! Bye!
Princess Bubblegum: They didn't need me.
Marceline: That's the win, Bonnie. You built a thing that works without you.
Princess Bubblegum: [quietly] Yeah. Yeah, it is. Are the twenty-four hours up?
Marceline: Not even close.
Princess Bubblegum: Good.
